Class manage_menu

java.lang.Object
controller.manage_menu
All Implemented Interfaces:
javafx.fxml.Initializable
public class manage_menu extends Object implements javafx.fxml.Initializable
Manager Menu Management Page.

Controls the manager page used to view and maintain menu items. The page displays menu records from the database and supports filtering, adding, editing, and deleting menu items.

The controller also validates menu form data, manages category and base-type behavior, displays status messages, preserves the logged-in manager username, and handles navigation between manager and employee pages.

1.0

    • initialize

      public void initialize(URL location, ResourceBundle resources)
      Initializes the menu management page when the FXML view is loaded.

      Configures the table columns, category choices, category filter, table click behavior, and initial menu data. Editing fields begin disabled, and category changes update whether Base Type can be entered.

      Specified by:
      initialize in interface javafx.fxml.Initializable
      Parameters:
      location - location used by JavaFX to resolve relative resources
      resources - resource bundle supplied by JavaFX during initialization

      Parameters:

    • setupTable

      private void setupTable()
      Configures the menu table columns.

      Each table column reads the matching value from the observable list representing one menu record.

    • setupTableClicks

      private void setupTableClicks()
      Configures mouse-click behavior for menu table rows.

      Clicking an empty row starts add mode. Clicking an existing row selects that menu item and displays its values without automatically enabling editing.

    • setupCategoryComboBox

      private void setupCategoryComboBox()
      Populates the category dropdown with the menu categories supported by the database.

    • setupFilterComboBox

      private void setupFilterComboBox()
      Configures the category filter used by the menu table.

      The default option displays all menu items. Changing the filter reloads the table using the matching database category.

    • loadMenu

      private void loadMenu()
      Loads menu records from the database into the menu table.

      The selected filter determines whether all records or one category is queried. Each database row is converted into an observable list containing ID, name, calories, category, base type, and cost.

    • displaySelectedItem

      private void displaySelectedItem(javafx.collections.ObservableList<String> row)
      Displays the selected menu item's values in the form.

      The selected item ID is stored for later edit or delete operations. Selecting an item does not automatically enter edit mode, so the fields remain disabled until Edit is selected.

      Parameters:
      row - selected menu row from the table

    • handleAdd

      private void handleAdd()
      Starts a new menu-item entry or saves the current add form.

      If add mode is already active and the form contains data, pressing Add again saves the new item. Otherwise, a fresh add operation is started.

    • startAddMode

      private void startAddMode()
      Prepares the page for adding a new menu item.

      The table selection and selected item ID are cleared, the form is reset, and the editable fields are enabled. Base Type remains disabled until a category is selected.

    • handleEdit

      private void handleEdit()
      Prepares the selected menu item for editing.

      The existing item ID is preserved so Save Changes updates the selected database record rather than creating a new one.

    • updateBaseTypeState

      private void updateBaseTypeState()
      Updates whether the Base Type field can be edited.

      The field remains disabled when no add or edit operation is active or when no category is selected. Toppings do not use a base type, while base drinks and seasonal drinks require one.

    • handleSave

      private void handleSave()
      Saves the operation represented by the current menu mode.

      Add mode creates a new menu item and edit mode updates the selected menu item. If neither mode is active, no database change is performed.

    • saveAdd

      private void saveAdd()
      Validates the form and inserts a new menu item into the database.

      A new item ID is calculated as one greater than the current maximum ID. The new record stores the entered name, calories, cost, category, and base type. Toppings store a null base type.

    • saveEdit

      private void saveEdit()
      Validates the form and updates the selected menu item.

      The update uses the original selected item ID and changes only that record. The affected-row count is checked for missing or duplicate IDs.

    • handleDelete

      private void handleDelete()
      Deletes the selected menu item after confirmation.

      A confirmation dialog displays the selected item name before deletion. The delete statement targets the selected item ID and checks the number of affected rows for missing or duplicate records.

    • validateForm

      private manage_menu.MenuFormData validateForm()
      Validates the values currently entered in the menu form.

      Name, calories, category, and cost are required. Base Type is required for base and seasonal drinks but is cleared for toppings. Calories must be a nonnegative whole number and cost must be a nonnegative number.

      Returns:
      validated menu data, or null when validation fails
